approval.reason: User explicitly requires complete exact bound assessment content and its protected write plan for separate approval; keep the proposed record in scratch until approval.

preconditions.structuralReview: Revalidate exact proposal in isolated scratch checkout against expectedHead and base with validateEvidence(preflight:true); no reported problems; match boundFingerprint. Abort on any mismatch.

operation.backup: Retain original bytes in isolated scratch before replacing.
operation.protection: After approval, verify all preconditions immediately before the write; replace only this regular file atomically; abort if HEAD, paths, hashes, scope, proposal bytes or fingerprint changed.
operation.postcondition: New file SHA-256 equals proposalSha256 and every other tracked-file hash remains unchanged; git diff contains only .bstack/assessment.json.

afterApprovedWrite: Review the exact applied assessment diff and revalidate portable binding.
Run complete standalone checker locally and in a fresh different-root clean clone with isolated home/cache against the same explicit base and committed assessment.

Before every Node suite run node "$BSTACK_EVAL_PREFLIGHT"; require exit zero, source host, permitted true, memory at least 8 GB, disk at least 20 GB, load below 36 and no more than two host-wide proposed-inclusive Node suites. Never kill another lane.
Record final current-head verification in scratch; no implementation, checks, historical snapshot or user-note changes.
executionState: Proposed only; no fixture write, commit or suite execution performed for this proposal.
